method: Per-display-cell ordinary least squares elevation trend over 2015, 2022, 2024, anchored to observed 2024 elevation
semantics: Exploratory historical-trend extrapolation; not a validated geomorphology forecast
drivers: Only historical elevations; no future rainfall, development, interventions, sediment transport or episodic events
uncertainty: No validated confidence interval. Geoid/survey offsets and historical disturbances may be extrapolated as apparent change.
